About The Uwe Seeler Trophy
Named for Uwe Seeler, who scored 30 goals for Hamburger SV to become the Bundesliga’s first top scorer in the inaugural 1963/64 season. The Trophy is seeded with 1. FC Köln, champions of that first Bundesliga season, completed on 9 May 1964. From the 1964/65 season onward, the title follows its holder through eligible German league matches: Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga and 3. Liga. A holder win or draw is a successful defence; a loss transfers the title. Relegation does not strip the Trophy, while DFB-Pokal, Supercup and European matches are outside scope. Current holder and next defence are loaded from the site data file. This is an unofficial fan project — not affiliated with the DFL, DFB, Bundesliga or any club.
